name: capcut_add_sound_effect
description: Drops a transient sound effect (whoosh, pop, click, riser impact) at an exact timeline timestamp, aligned with visual keyframes or text pops.

sfx_file_path.description: Absolute path to sound effect audio file (.wav, .mp3).

timestamp_seconds.description: Timeline timestamp in seconds where the SFX should trigger.

track_index.description: Audio track index for SFX (default track 1).
